name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 28, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Member of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82779998658
  Webinar ID: 827 7999 8658
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,82779998658# OR +16699009128,,82779998658#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of January 24, 2024 Study Session, January 24, 2024 Regular Meeting and
February 7, 2024 City Council Regular Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. Four Seasons Hotel Westlake Village – Recognition for Investments made in
  Westlake Village

  2. 2023 Recycling All-Star Awards presented by WM and the City of Westlake
  Village to:

  •  Four Seasons Hotel Westlake Village
  •  Warner Pacific

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda and within the Council’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.
Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 94-006 MODIFICATION NO. 2;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2333-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2333-24, determining
  Modification No. 2 to Planned Development Permit No. 94-006 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing a modification to the conditions of approval to allow outdoor food
  service and dining at the Costco located at 5700 Lindero Canyon Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2333-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 2 TO PLANNED DEVELOPMENT
  PERMIT NO. 94-006, AUTHORIZING A CHANGE TO THE CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL TO
  ALLOW OUTDOOR FOOD SERVICE AND DINING AT THE COSTCO LOCATED AT 5700
  LINDERO CANYON ROAD

2.  ALLOCATION OF FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025 COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM FUNDS; RESOLUTION NO. 2334-24 – Adopt
  Resolution No. 2334-24.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2334-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING ALLOCATIONS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025 FOR
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective February 15, 2024 in the amount
  of $ 631,587.78

  GENERAL BUSINESS:
  1.  CULTURAL RECREATION ADVISORY BOARD APPOINTMENTS AND
  GUIDELINE UPDATES - Appoint Isabella Ordonez and Christian Ipsen as
  Student Members and Amy Brink, Elisa Hirsch and Rachel Murray to the
  Cultural Recreation Advisory Board with the term ending December 31, 2025
  and approve the revised Cultural Recreation Advisory Board Guidelines.

  2.  TICKET/PASS DISTRIBUTION POLICY ADOPTION; RESOLUTION NO.
  2335-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2335-24.
  RESOLUTION NO. 2335-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING A TICKET / PASS DISTRIBUTION POLICY IN
  COMPLIANCE WITH FAIR POLITICAL PRACTICES COMMISSION REGULATION
  18944.1
   3.  CANYON  OAKS  PARK  SHADE  STRUCTURE  PROJECT
  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF PURCHASE AGREEMENT
  AWARD, INSTALLATION AGREEMENT AWARD, AND CEQA
  EXEMPTION DETERMINATION – Make a CEQA Notice of Exemption
  determination for the Shade Structure at Canyon Oaks Park Project; approve
  a Purchase Agreement with RecWest Outdoor Products, Inc. in the amount
  of $43,037.46;  approve an Installation Agreement with Evergreen
  Environment, Inc. in the amount of $29,980.00 and authorize the Mayor to
  sign and execute the agreements on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  JOINT USE AGREEMENT BEWEEN THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AND
  THE LAS VIRGENES UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT FOR PUBLIC ACCESS TO
  THE WHITE OAK ELEMENTARY SCHOOL FIELD AND CAMPUS DURING NON-
  SCHOOL HOURS – Approve the Joint Use Agreement between the City and the
  Las Virgenes Unified School District (LVUSD) for public access to the White Oak
  Elementary School Field during non-school hours.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, February 23, 2024 at 12:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  February 23, 2024
